--- title: "Pakistan's Exports: What Sells and Where It Goes" subtitle: "A self-updating report, pulled live from the SBP EasyData API at every render" author: "Zahid Asghar" date: today date-format: "D MMMM YYYY" params: rediscover: false # true scans SBP for country and product series codes format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 embed-resources: true fig-width: 9 fig-height: 5 execute: echo: false warning: false message: false editor_options: chunk_output_type: console --- ::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"} ## The story so far (data to August 2026) In August 2026, Pakistan exported goods worth $2.46 billion, down 1.1% on August 2025. Over the last twelve months goods exports reached $31.03 billion, down 5.3% on the year before. FY2025-26 closed at $30.82 billion (down 4.7%). The first 2 months of FY2026-27 brought in $5.44 billion, up 4.0% on the same months of FY2025-26. Services added another $10.43 billion over the last twelve months, 25.2% of total exports. ::: Every number above is calculated at render time from data downloaded from SBP EasyData on 22 September 2026. SBP occasionally fails a request, so each series is tried up to four times. Destination and product sections appear automatically once their series codes are listed in `sbp_export_series.csv` (build it with `-P rediscover:true`); until then the report covers goods and services only. ::: {#tbl-directory .cell} ::: ## Appendix: code ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} library(tidyverse) library(httr2) library(tsibble) library(knitr) library(plotly) library(plotly) if (!exists("params")) params <- list(rediscover = FALSE) theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12)) start_date <- "2001-07-01" keys_file <- "sbp_export_series.csv" # series codes and names only, no data # Headline exports, BPM6 monthly summary headline_keys <- c( goods = "TS_GP_BOP_BPM6SUM_M.P00030", # Exports of goods FOB services = "TS_GP_BOP_BPM6SUM_M.P00060" # Exports of services ) # Breakdowns and candidate series-code prefixes (used only when scanning) blocks <- tribble( ~block, ~dataset, ~prefixes, "country", "TS_GP_BOP_XRECCOU_M", list(c("EXPC", "EXPA")), # EXPC mirrors the confirmed IMPC "product", "TS_GP_BOP_XRECCOM_M", list(c("EXPA", "EXPC")) # EXPA confirmed: ...XRECCOM_M.EXPA00420 ) block_title <- c(country = "export destinations", product = "export products") country_agg <- regex(str_c( "\\btotal\\b|countries|region|union|world|unspecified|not specified|n\\.e\\.s|", "^(asia|africa|europe|oceania|america)\\b|^(north|south|latin|central) america|", "^(east|west|south|central|north)(ern)? (asia|europe)|middle east|far east|", "\\bgcc\\b|saarc|asean|opec|commonwealth|^others?\\b" ), ignore_case = TRUE) product_agg <- regex("\\btotal\\b|^others?\\b|\\bgroup\\b", ignore_case = TRUE) sbp_key <- Sys.getenv("SBP_EASYDATA_KEY") if (!nzchar(sbp_key)) { stop("SBP_EASYDATA_KEY not found. Add it with usethis::edit_r_environ() and restart R.") } sbp_req <- function(key, start = start_date, end = Sys.Date(), timeout = 30) { request("https://easydata.sbp.org.pk/api/v1/series") |> req_url_path_append(key, "data") |> req_url_query(api_key = sbp_key, format = "json", start_date = as.character(as.Date(start)), end_date = as.character(as.Date(end))) |> req_headers(Accept = "application/json") |> req_user_agent("pakistan-export-report (R httr2)") |> req_timeout(timeout) |> req_error(is_error = \(r) FALSE) } # SBP JSON: { columns: [...], rows: [[dataset, key, name, date, value, unit, ...], ...] } parse_sbp <- function(resp, key) { body <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = FALSE) if (is.null(body$rows) || length(body$rows) == 0) return(NULL) cols <- str_to_lower(unlist(body$columns)) find <- function(pattern, fallback) { i <- which(str_detect(cols, pattern)) if (length(i) == 0) fallback else i[1] } i_name <- find("series name|^series$", 3) i_date <- find("observation date", 4) i_val <- find("observation value", 5) cell <- function(r, i) if (length(r) >= i && !is.null(r[[i]])) as.character(r[[i]]) else NA_character_ tibble( key = key, series_name = map_chr(body$rows, cell, i = i_name), date = map_chr(body$rows, cell, i = i_date), value = map_chr(body$rows, cell, i = i_val) ) |> mutate( month = yearmonth(as.Date(parse_date_time(date, c("Ymd", "dbY", "dby", "dmY"), quiet = TRUE))), value = parse_number(value) ) |> filter(!is.na(month), !is.na(value)) |> select(key, series_name, month, value) } safe_parse <- possibly(parse_sbp, otherwise = NULL) empty_pull <- tibble(key = character(), series_name = character(), month = yearmonth(as.Date(character())), value = numeric()) # One series at a time, with patient retries. SBP sometimes fails a call and # answers the same call a few seconds later, so each series gets up to # `attempts` tries with growing waits. pull_keys <- function(keys, start = start_date, timeout = 30, attempts = 4, waits = c(2, 5, 10), pause = 0.8, deadline = Inf, verbose = TRUE) { keys <- unique(keys) if (length(keys) == 0) return(empty_pull) out <- vector("list", length(keys)) for (i in seq_along(keys)) { note <- "" for (a in seq_len(attempts)) { if (Sys.time() > deadline) break Sys.sleep(if (a == 1) pause else waits[min(a - 1, length(waits))]) resp <- tryCatch(req_perform(sbp_req(keys[i], start = start, timeout = timeout)), error = \(e) e) if (!inherits(resp, "httr2_response")) { note <- str_c("request failed: ", conditionMessage(resp)) } else if (resp_status(resp) != 200) { note <- str_c("HTTP ", resp_status(resp)) if (resp_status(resp) == 404) break # wrong code, no point retrying } else { out[[i]] <- safe_parse(resp, keys[i]) if (!is.null(out[[i]])) { note <- str_c("ok, ", nrow(out[[i]]), " rows"); break } note <- "HTTP 200 but no usable rows" } } if (verbose) message(sprintf(" [%d/%d] %s %s (attempt %d)", i, length(keys), keys[i], note, a)) if (Sys.time() > deadline) { message(" time limit reached, stopping"); break } } out <- list_rbind(out) if (is.null(out) || ncol(out) == 0) empty_pull else out } # Scanning is OFF by default. Run it once with -P rediscover:true, or write # sbp_export_series.csv by hand with columns: block, key, series_name. code_keys <- function(dataset, prefix, width, codes) { str_c(dataset, ".", prefix, str_pad(codes, width, pad = "0")) } # Walk the codes upward in steps of 10. Stop when there has been no hit for a # long stretch, so the scan ends by itself once the list of series runs out. scan_prefix <- function(dataset, prefix, deadline, width = 5, step = 10, give_up_before_first = 80, give_up_after_last = 40) { recent <- Sys.Date() - 540 hits <- list(); misses <- 0; code <- step; any_hit <- FALSE repeat { if (Sys.time() > deadline) { message(" time limit reached"); break } key <- code_keys(dataset, prefix, width, code) got <- pull_keys(key, start = recent, timeout = 10, attempts = 2, waits = 2, pause = 0.3, verbose = FALSE) if (nrow(got) > 0) { any_hit <- TRUE; misses <- 0 hits[[length(hits) + 1]] <- got |> summarise(series_name = last(series_name), .by = key) message(" ", key, " ", last(got$series_name)) } else { misses <- misses + 1 } if (!any_hit && misses >= give_up_before_first) break if (any_hit && misses >= give_up_after_last) break code <- code + step } list_rbind(hits) } discover_block <- function(dataset, prefixes, deadline) { for (p in prefixes) { message("Scanning ", dataset, ".", p, "...") found <- scan_prefix(dataset, p, deadline) if (!is.null(found) && nrow(found) > 0) return(found) } NULL } if (isTRUE(params$rediscover)) { deadline <- Sys.time() + 20 * 60 message("Scanning SBP for export series (max 20 minutes)...") found <- blocks |> mutate(found = map2(dataset, prefixes, \(d, p) discover_block(d, p, deadline))) |> select(block, found) |> unnest(found) if (nrow(found) > 0) write_csv(found, keys_file) } directory <- if (file.exists(keys_file)) { read_csv(keys_file, show_col_types = FALSE) } else { tibble(block = character(), key = character(), series_name = character()) } raw <- pull_keys(c(headline_keys, directory$key)) pulled_on <- format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y") if (!headline_keys[["goods"]] %in% raw$key) { stop("SBP did not return goods exports (", headline_keys[["goods"]], ") after several tries. ", "The messages above show what SBP answered; please render again in a few minutes.") } roll12 <- function(x) as.numeric(stats::filter(x, rep(1, 12), sides = 1)) # ---- Headline exports ---- exp_m <- raw |> filter(key %in% headline_keys) |> mutate(series = names(headline_keys)[match(key, headline_keys)], value = abs(value)) |> distinct(month, series, .keep_all = TRUE) |> select(month, series, value) |> pivot_wider(names_from = series, values_from = value) |> (\(d) { if (!"services" %in% names(d)) d$services <- NA_real_; d })() |> arrange(month) |> filter(!is.na(goods)) |> mutate( goods12 = roll12(goods), serv12 = roll12(services), goods_yoy = goods / lag(goods, 12) - mean_v, .by = block ) |> mutate( total_key = { cand <- key[named_total] if (length(cand) > 0) cand[which.max(mean_v[named_total])] else if (max(mean_v) > 0.5 * others_sum[which.max(mean_v)]) key[which.max(mean_v)] else NA_character_ }, total_mean = if (all(is.na(total_key))) NA_real_ else mean_v[key == first(total_key)], .by = block ) |> mutate(role = case_when( key == total_key ~ "Total", block == "country" & str_detect(label, country_agg) ~ "Aggregate", block == "product" & str_detect(label, product_agg) ~ "Aggregate", !is.na(total_mean) & mean_v > 0.5 * total_mean ~ "Aggregate", .default = "Item" )) items <- detail |> semi_join(filter(series_info, role == "Item"), by = join_by(key)) |> summarise(value = sum(value), .by = c(block, label, month)) block_totals <- bind_rows( detail |> semi_join(filter(series_info, role == "Total"), by = join_by(key)) |> select(block, month, value), items |> filter(!block %in% series_info$block[series_info$role == "Total"]) |> summarise(value = sum(value), .by = c(block, month)) ) } else { series_info <- tibble(block = character(), key = character(), label = character(), mean_v = numeric(), role = character()) items <- tibble(block = character(), label = character(), month = yearmonth(as.Date(character())), value = numeric()) block_totals <- tibble(block = character(), month = yearmonth(as.Date(character())), value = numeric()) } has <- as.list(set_names(names(block_title) %in% unique(items$block), names(block_title))) usd <- function(x) { x <- unname(x) if_else(abs(x) >= 1000, str_c("$", format(round(abs(x) / 1000, 2), nsmall = 2), " billion"), str_c("$", format(round(abs(x)), big.mark = ","), " million")) } pct <- function(x, d = 1) str_c(format(round(100 * abs(unname(x)), d), nsmall = d), "%") chg <- function(x) if_else(is.na(x), "new", str_c(if_else(x >= 0, "up ", "down "), pct(x))) mlab <- function(m) format(as.Date(m), "%B %Y") fylab <- function(fy) str_c("FY", fy -
